canonical_serialization.sha256_scope: entire JSON value excluding external evidence checksum

partition.view: all event-valid transactions with full history-v1 coverage at or after the 24-hour warmup cutoff; labels do not affect membership
partition.rule: chronological 70/15/15 by row count; sort by event_time_utc then transaction_id; timestamp groups remain intact; choose the nearest cumulative whole-timestamp boundary; equal distance chooses the earlier boundary

train.purpose: supervised model fitting and all learned preprocessing

validation.purpose: candidate selection and scorer-specific threshold selection only

test.purpose: sealed final metrics only after model, transforms, thresholds and predictions are frozen

label_roles.train: eligible labels may fit candidates and training-only transforms
label_roles.validation: eligible labels may select candidates and thresholds; never fit preprocessing or estimator parameters
label_roles.test: labels remain sealed until all model artifacts, thresholds and per-row predictions are frozen and verified

candidates.remaining_estimator_parameters: pinned scikit-learn 1.9.1 defaults, recorded in each fit manifest
candidates.class_imbalance: retain natural training prevalence; no class weights, resampling or synthetic examples

preprocessing.numeric: training-fold median imputation with missingness indicators; standard scaling fitted on train for logistic regression only
preprocessing.categorical: explicit missing-value category followed by one-hot encoding; unknown validation/test categories ignored using the frozen encoder

tie_break_order: higher validation average precision outside the tie tolerance
higher validation Precision@K when average precision differs by at most the tie tolerance
selection.ranking_ties: descending score then ascending stable transaction_id; disclose any score tie crossing K
selection.recall_at_k_denominator: all eligible positive labels in that partition

threshold_selection.candidates: each distinct validation score as an inclusive threshold, plus symbolic no-alert above the maximum

baseline.comparison_population: identical label-eligible transaction IDs for each role
baseline.threshold_selection: same validation-only F0.5 policy as model; scorer-specific numeric threshold

reporting.reliability_bins: 10 equal-width bins over [0,1]; report each nonempty bin's count, mean prediction and observed positive fraction; descriptive only
reporting.uncertainty: not quantified unless a dependence-aware method is declared before test disclosure; state reason and limitation
reporting.probability_claim: model outputs are uncalibrated estimates; rules-v1 scores are ordinal and receive no Brier score
reporting.comparison: rules-v1 and selected model use identical eligible transaction IDs and metric definitions

resource_budget.source: T028 resource-pilot prospective recommendation; these are stop ceilings, not demonstrated model-fit capacity
resource_budget.on_limit: stop and record controlled failure; do not relax limits or switch runtime
resource_budget.training_view_reduction: none; use the complete chronological train role and preserve validation/test roles

label_free_review_sample.selection: sort by SHA-256 of UTF-8 prefix 'FraudLensAI/feature-002/v1/review\0' concatenated with transaction_id; take the five smallest digests; labels are not read
label_free_review_sample.purpose: manual explanation and provenance review only; not a metric population or selection input

required_order: freeze selected model and fitted transforms
freeze rules/model validation thresholds and calibration status
produce all test predictions without reading test labels
persist and verify prediction identities, values and hashes
join test labels once for final metrics and atomically mark holdout consumed
holdout.reuse: any later access is exploratory only; no confirmatory claim, model selection, retraining or threshold change

reference_methodology.use: methodological reference only; no upstream code, dataset, features, thresholds, weights or results transferred
reference_methodology.license_status: no repository LICENSE file is visible in the upstream root listing; permission to copy code is unconfirmed, so no upstream code was copied
